definitions.explanation: Literally 'a bee sting on a crying face.' One piece of bad luck followed by another.

examples.japanese: {泣|な}きっ{面|つら}に{蜂|はち}だ。
⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくした⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{降|ふ}られて→降る：00839_furu⟧、{泣|な}きっ{面|つら}に{蜂|はち}だった。
examples.english: I lost my wallet and then got caught in the rain. One thing after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひく⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{泣|な}きっ{面|つら}に{蜂|はち}だ。
examples.english: Catching a cold on the very day I failed the exam: talk about bad luck piling up.

notes:
{泣|な}きっ{面|つら} is a colloquial form of {泣|な}き{面|つら}, a tearful face.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弱|よわ}り{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{祟|たた}り{目|め}: the same meaning, more old-fashioned
- ⟦{踏|ふ}ん→踏む：01197_fumu⟧だり⟦{蹴|け}っ→蹴る：02054_keru⟧たり: being kicked when you're down (colloquial)
